memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: This was the allotment for the tribe of Manasseh as Joseph's firstborn, that is, for Makir, Manasseh's firstborn. Makir was the ancestor of the Gileadites, who had received Gilead and Bashan because the Makirites were great soldiers. So this allotment was for the rest of the people of Manasseh—the clans of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher and Shemida. These are the other male descendants of Manasseh, according to their clans - Josh 17:1-2 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The inheritance now turns to the rest of Manasseh, Joseph's firstborn son. The writer carefully names the clans, making sure each branch of the family is accounted for. Even in a long genealogical record, God's concern is that no one is left out. Every clan has its place; every family is remembered.

Notice how Gilead and Bashan had already been given to the Makirites because they were "great soldiers." God had used their strength, and He honoured it with an inheritance. But the passage moves on immediately to provide for "the rest of the people of Manasseh" — those not singled out as mighty warriors. The strong were not the only ones to receive; God made sure the ordinary clans were given their portion too.

There is comfort in this for all of us who are not the standout heroes. God does not provide only for the impressive and the mighty. He remembers the ordinary families, the clans whose names we can barely pronounce, and gives each one a genuine inheritance. In God's family, no one is overlooked because they are not remarkable. Every believer, however unremarkable in the world's eyes, is written into God's account and given a share in Christ (Gal 3:28-29). The God who named each clan of Manasseh knows and provides for you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you ever feel overlooked because you are not one of the "great soldiers"?
- How does God's care for every clan of Manasseh reassure you?
- What does it mean that your name is written into God's family through Christ?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You provide for the ordinary, not only the impressive. Remind me that I am not overlooked, but written into Your family and given a share in Christ. Amen.
